meaning.en: Helio is defined as something related to light, the sun, or sunlight.

sentences.en: Double Image Micrometers are described in the article HELIO METER (q.v.).

sentences.en: Hough went on to win the trophy a second time in season five with her partner, Indy 500 racer Helio Castroneves.

sentences.en: For more specifics and perspectives, check out our article on Helio Ocean reviews.

sentences.en: The stereo headset plugs directly into your Helio Ocean, serving two key functions.

sentences.en: The USB cable lets you easily connect your Helio device with your computer.
sentences.vi: Cáp USB cho phép bạn dễ dàng kết nối thiết bị Helio với máy tính.

sentences.en: The headset port on the Helio Ocean is 2.5mm, but most standard earphones -- like those included with your iPod -- use a 3.5mm jack.
sentences.vi: Cổng tai nghe trên Helio Ocean là 2,5mm, nhưng hầu hết các tai nghe tiêu chuẩn - như những chiếc đi kèm với iPod của bạn - đều sử dụng giắc cắm 3,5mm.

sentences.en: It's time to personalize with a bunch of Helio Ocean accessories.

sentences.en: A microSD memory card can expand the capacity of your Helio Ocean -- which has 200MB of internal memory -- by up to 1GB.
sentences.vi: Thẻ nhớ microSD có thể mở rộng dung lượng của Helio Ocean - có bộ nhớ trong 200MB - lên đến 1GB.
